# Swiss Atelier

> A living information design system for technical documents, ADRs, and editorial diagrams. Fraunces 500 headings, Literata 440 prose, Geist UI/mono, hairline surfaces, and semantic orange/teal accents. Version 1.1.0.

## Start here

- [Agent skill](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/skills/swiss-atelier/SKILL.md): Explicit user invocation only via $swiss-atelier or a request to use Swiss Atelier. Preserve the requested format; HTML requires an HTML/web-page request.
- [Human guide](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/README.md): Integration, skill installation, local development, and limitations.
- [Living specimen](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/): Nine interactive design modules.
- [Starter HTML](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/templates/starter-adr.html): Draft ADR with context, decision, consequences, evidence, and review prompts.

- [Diagram starter](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/templates/starter-diagram.html): Portable conceptual topology and independent text equivalent.
- [Integration example](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/templates/starter-integration.html): Public CSS and optional runtime only.
- [Authoring method](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/skills/swiss-atelier/references/authoring.md): Audience, evidence, outlines, reader checks.
- [Diagram method](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/skills/swiss-atelier/references/diagrams.md): Representation choice, scope, notation, omissions.
- [Distribution](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/skills/swiss-atelier/references/distribution.md): Coherent current-main, pinned, and vendored recipes; token coverage.

## Public assets

- [Shared CSS](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/dist/atelier.css): Tokens, typography, components, and Google Fonts import.
- [Runtime](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/dist/atelier.js): Code highlighting, line numbers, focal/verified highlights, async clipboard helper.
- [DTCG typed tokens](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/dist/tokens.json): Authoritative token values and CSS-name extensions.

## Maintenance

- [Agent repository guide](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/AGENTS.md): Sources, invariants, public API, and verification.
- [Contributing](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development and release workflow.
- [Accessibility](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/docs/accessibility.md): Color and keyboard guidance; limitations.
- [Changelog](https://jeonkwan.github.io/swiss-atelier-design-system/CHANGELOG.md): Version history.
- [Repository](https://github.com/Jeonkwan/swiss-atelier-design-system): Source and issues.

Pages assets and guidance track the same deployed main build. For stable 1.1.0 consumption, use its complete tagged tree and matching assets. For historical v1.0.0 use its complete tagged tree, skill, tokens, template, CSS, and JS; do not mix the new contextual-token recipes with old CSS. See distribution above. Fonts use Google Fonts with fallbacks. Copy the complete skill directory, including agents/openai.yaml and references/. Installation or discovery does not activate the skill; explicit user invocation is required. Companion skills are optional; Swiss branding remains authoritative. Print/no-JS/offline typography/CJK delivery extensions are deferred.
